g.text: // Add for: REMORA / OYSTER / YABBY / DIGITAL_MATTER
-32700 - New loaded is recorded passively on FM units only
29400 - FM&M4K : Config Accepted is sent ONLY as an
Active Message once the unit starts up with a new config
29450 - FM&M4K : Config Confirmed is sent BOTH as
Active and Passive message 2700 seconds after
William/GPRS: IF not see 29400 for FM units.
I suspect the 29450 you see for the FM is the passive one,
